realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Artisan
primary.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
primary.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
primary.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

secondary.label: Guardian
secondary.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
secondary.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

wheel.central_question: Should we create the new, or perfect the existing?

growth.label: Guardian
growth.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
growth.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
growth.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

other_ally.label: Healer
other_ally.description: Cares deeply; others' suffering is what they fear most.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will ease what hurts, and protect what heals.
other_ally.shadow_description: Absorbs everyone else's pain until there's nothing left to tend their own.

quarter.label: Craftsman
quarter.description: Believes excellence lives in the smallest details; discipline borders on devotion.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will refine this until it is right, no matter how long that takes.
quarter.shadow_description: Keeps refining what was already good enough, and calls the compulsion discipline.

opposite.label: Inventor
opposite.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
opposite.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Historian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
